plan.notes: Source: SUNY Adirondack official SmartCatalogIQ 'Business Administration AS (BADM)' page (sunyacc.smartcatalogiq.com, 24-25 catalog), published 'Recommended Sequence' transcribed exactly as published: 13+16+16+15 = 60, consistent with the degree's component totals (program core 29 + business electives 6 + freshman seminar + writing + two math requirements + natural sciences + history + anthropology + liberal arts = 60-64). Variable-credit slots resolved at minimum: First Semester freshman seminar transcribed as HRD 110 (1 cr; alternatives HRD 100/100A at 2); both math requirements transcribed at 3 credits (MAT 108 Sem 1; MAT 121 Sem 2); Fourth Semester Natural Sciences transcribed at 3. Prerequisite ordering verified: BUS 146 Financial Accounting (Sem 2) before BUS 147 Management Accounting (Sem 3); BUS 201 Business Law I (Sem 3) before BUS 202 Business Law II (Sem 4); ENG 101 (Sem 1) before Writing II (Sem 2); ECO 201 Principles of Macroeconomics (Sem 3) before ECO 202 Principles of Microeconomics (Sem 4). Published choice slots documented: Sem 1 management/marketing = BUS 102 Principles of Management or BUS 103 Principles of Marketing (BUS 102 transcribed); Sem 3 = the one not taken in Sem 1 (BUS 103 transcribed); Writing II = ENG 102-110 (ENG 102 transcribed); Business electives = any AGR, BUS, ECO, or HOS course. Published math advisement: MAT 131 Calculus I recommended/required for SUNY Transfer Path junior status at most major SUNY universities; students may need MAT 108 per placement. Degree classification: AS = transfer-oriented ('designed for students who wish to transfer to a baccalaureate business or economics curriculum'). Catalog year honest note: 24-25 is the newest SmartCatalogIQ edition with indexed program pages; re-verify against the 25-26 edition when available.
